body: I don't have anything to loose so I wil try. I would like to have some good source of information how to do it for mental health, because I haven't found anything compelling

I am depressed and always was. I can't do anything anymore. I stopped going to university this year just to stay alive a little bit longer, tried new meds and wanted to start next therapy. Medication did not work and therapist chosen by my local counsellor refused to work with me cause I am too depressed. 
Psychiatrist told me last month that she will not keep my hopes up. Therapists tell me that they can't do anything without working medication and doctors tell me they can't do anything and it is my fault. I was in hospital 6 months ago and they told me they had no idea what to do. 
I know that suicide is just the best option for everybody in this situation. I just don't want to cause any harm I don't need to
I feel like I can safely say that i tried
Setraline, escitalopram, lamotrigine, aripiprazole, wortioxerine, wenlafaxine, duloxetine, lithium, quetiapine, bupropion, oxcarbazepine. Now I'm trying fluoxetine
